title: Gift of Everlasting Radiance and Unreasonably Benevolent Sparkles Beyond the Comprehension of Mortal Minds

Description

"Behold the Transcendentally Overqualified Beacon of Hyper Glittering Benevolence Whose Unsolicited Acts Of Magnanimous Sparkle-Dispersion Cascading Across the Cosmos Create Such Blindingly Benevolent Luminosity That Even Ancient Star-forges, Primal Creation Serpents, and the Department of Interdimensional Radiance Compliance Agree It Is Probably a Bit Much but They Allow it Anyway Because it Smells Faintly of Vanilla and Hope."

*yes i really typed all this out by hand*

Price

  • Sold at the Santa's Workshop for 25,000❄️

Trivia

  • This item has the biggest name and description in Oaklands
  • You might be wondering: "What's inside?", right? Well, let me tell you: It's Coal.
